name: voorrah
description: Practice questions on the Dutch traffic rules (RVV 1990) and the CBR driving exam, with pictures: who-goes-first junction puzzles, road signs and rule questions. Each answer comes with the rule behind it.

interface.longDescription: Practise the Dutch traffic rules for your driving licence, one question at a time. Voorrah! shows a junction drawn from above and asks who goes first, shows a road sign and asks what it means, or asks about a rule from its driving lessons. Pick an answer in the card or type it in the chat: you see at once whether it is right, why, and which article of the Dutch traffic rules (RVV 1990) or which part of the CBR exam procedure it comes from. Questions do not repeat in a chat. The questions come from Voorrah!, a driving game set in Amsterdam, and every answer links to the rule's page and to the game, where you can practise it as a drive.
capabilities: Answers with the rule behind them
defaultPrompt: Quiz me on Dutch driving rules
Who goes first at a Dutch roundabout? Give me a practice question.
Test me on Dutch road signs

positive.prompt: Quiz me on Dutch driving rules
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with a picture (a junction drawing or a road sign), one question and 2-4 answer options. The answer is not shown or hinted at.

positive.prompt: Who goes first at a Dutch roundabout? Give me a practice question.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls quiz_question with topic junctions and search roundabout, and shows a drawn roundabout with labelled road users A and B and the question who goes first.

positive.prompt: Test me on Dutch road signs
positive.expected_behavior: Calls quiz_question with topic signs and shows a Dutch road sign with the question 'What does this sign mean?' and three options.

positive.prompt: Quiz me on Dutch traffic signs. (After the card appears, reply: B)
positive.expected_behavior: After the reply 'B', calls quiz_answer with the question's id and B, then says whether B is right, gives the right answer, the explanation and the RVV 1990 rule it comes from.

positive.description: Answer in the card, then the next question
positive.prompt: Give me a Dutch driving theory question about trams
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a question about trams. Tapping an option in the card marks it right or wrong, shows the explanation and the rule; 'Next question' shows a different question in the same card.

negative.description: Booking an exam is not something the app does
negative.prompt: Book a CBR driving exam for me next week
What is the speed limit on German motorways?
Write a short poem about cycling along the Amsterdam canals

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell anything or process payments. It shows practice questions and links to the rule pages and the game on voorrah.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: junction puzzles, road signs and rule questions with pictures, answers with the rule behind them.
